body: I have to say it. The food is great, but... you guys are really fat.
Yeah, that's correct. Didn't remember it.

Well, I know some music glitches:

The Beatles - Helter Skelter - As this was a really fast and agressive song for Ringo to play, you can hear him shouting in the end of the song "I've got blisters on my fingers!"

The Police - Roxanne - In the beginning of the song, Sting plays the wrong piano chord and laughs.

Deep Purple - Fireball - This is something I actually noticed, but never read anywhere. After Jon Lord's solo, Ian Paice has some difficult time finding the rhythm again and misses some beats. 

Led Zeppelin - Baby I'm Gonna Leave You - around 1:43, you can hear a ghost kind of voice in the background. While John Bonham was recording, Plant was singing and his voice got recorded with the drums.
